title: Add entry
subtitle: Record income, expenses and partner investments — VAT is calculated as you type.

empty.noModelsHint: Add at least one business type (e.g. Rental, Repair) in Settings before recording income.
empty.noCategoriesHint: Add expense categories in Settings before recording expenses.

validation.amountInvalid: Enter an amount greater than zero, e.g. 45 or 45,50
validation.discountTooHigh: The discount cannot be larger than the amount
validation.receivedByRequired: Choose who received the money when the status is Paid
validation.pctInvalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 100
validation.partnerRequired: Choose the partner, or switch to Joint

pickers.unitPlaceholder: Search by unit ID, brand or model…
pickers.unitsFailed: Could not load the unit list.
pickers.customerPlaceholder: Type a name — or pick a saved customer
pickers.noCustomers: No saved customer found — the name is saved as typed
pickers.customersFailed: Customer search failed — the name is saved as typed

income.unitHint: Optional — links the income to a scooter for payback tracking.
income.customerHint: Optional. Free text, or pick a saved customer from the list.
income.enterNet: Enter net price (VAT is added on top)
income.netNeedsVatInvoice: Without a VAT invoice the amount is non-VAT income, so it is used exactly as typed.
income.rateUnusedHint: Not applied — no VAT invoice issued.
income.vatDefaultHint: Pre-filled from who received the money and the payment method — you can change it.
income.receivedByHint: Required once the status is Paid.
income.notesPlaceholder: What was sold or done — shown as the entry description

success.title: Saved: {{amount}} — {{model}}
success.paidBack: Unit {{code}} has paid itself back — {{earned}} earned so far.
success.paybackNoCost: Unit {{code}} has earned {{earned}} so far (no purchase price recorded).
success.needsReview: This entry was flagged for review.

expense.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. Brake pads, shop rent March
expense.noReceiptHint: Without a valid VAT receipt no VAT can be reclaimed.
expense.businessUseHint: Share used for the business (100 = fully business).
expense.paidByHint: Who paid. A partner's own money is recorded as their investment.
expense.jointHint: Paid from shared profit — counted as a joint investment split 50/50.
expense.unitHint: Optional — e.g. parts or repairs for a specific scooter.
expense.receiptHint: JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC or PDF, max 10 MB. Uploaded after the expense is saved.
expense.fileTooLarge: The file is larger than 10 MB
expense.receiptFailed: The expense was saved, but the receipt upload failed. {{message}}

success.title: Saved: {{amount}} — {{description}}
success.receiptRetry: Receipt not attached — choose the file again to retry.
success.voided: This expense was voided as a duplicate.

duplicates.title: Possible duplicate expense
duplicates.message_one: The new expense #{{id}} has the same vendor and amount as an existing expense within 3 days. Keep it if it is a separate purchase, or void it.
duplicates.message_other: The new expense #{{id}} has the same vendor and amount as {{count}} existing expenses within 3 days. Keep it if it is a separate purchase, or void it.
duplicates.keep: Keep — it is a separate purchase
duplicates.confirmMessage: Expense #{{id}} will be marked as void. Its VAT and any partner investment it created will no longer count. This cannot be undone.

investment.jointHint: A joint investment is shared equally between the partners.
investment.noPartners: No partners are set up, so investments are recorded as joint.
investment.notePlaceholder: e.g. Cash added to the till for change
investment.infoText: Manual rows only. Unit purchases and expenses paid by a partner create their investment rows automatically.

investmentCategoryHint.UNITS: scooters, e-bikes or mopeds bought for the business
investmentCategoryHint.SPARE_PARTS: parts bought with a partner's own money
investmentCategoryHint.EXPENSES: running costs a partner paid personally
investmentCategoryHint.CASH_INJECTED: money put into the company account or till

preview.title: Live preview
preview.hint: Calculated as you type, exactly like the saved entry.
preview.netModeHint: Net price entered — VAT is added on top.
preview.empty: Enter an amount to see the VAT breakdown.
preview.expenseHint: VAT you can deduct from this purchase.
